facts.fact: The Liberia Revenue Authority published its Annual Report for fiscal year 2023, reporting US$715.9 million collected by its Domestic Tax and Customs Departments, which attest that the data is a faithful representation of the underlying tax returns of the system. Date is the report's publication/attestation date, 30 June 2024; the figures cover FY2023.
facts.system: Liberia Revenue Authority Annual Report, Fiscal Year 2023

facts.fact: The report says the LRA is integrating its LITAS tax system with the National Identification Registry for ID verification and with GT Bank for real-time payment data, with Ecobank, UBA, the Central Bank, Lonestar Cell-MTN and Orange work in progress; date is the report's publication date, 2024-06-30.
